data.title: bn-q7sy: Expose byte-exact binary evidence reads by Artifact ID and bounded selector
data.description: Expose exact selected bytes as padded standard base64 in excerpt.bytes_base64 after disclosure, digest, integrity and selector checks. Finalized-capture CLI coverage exercises whole and bounded reads, full artifact binding, invalid ranges, corruption outside the slice and classification denial. Focused regression, v1 schema publication and full just check-offline passed. The standalone dependency audit also passed.

data.reason: LGTM from the lead. The change is minimal: bytes_base64 is added only to Excerpt::Binary, on the existing evidence_read path. That path still applies the restricted-content gate (Classifier may_show Content under the default audience), the retained-bytes gate, size/digest verification, and the 32 KiB MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES bound before encoding, so the disclosure posture is unchanged: these are the same bytes a text excerpt would already return. Excerpt is CLI output only, never persisted into events or a v1 schema; base64 =0.22.1 was already in the lockfile. Non-blocking nit: the text-mode line 'Binary content is retained in the workspace.' (cli/src/evidence.rs:277) could add 'use --format json for excerpt.bytes_base64', so a --help-only agent finds the bytes. The workspace is stale against main; sync and run just check before merging. I will merge through edict once the bone is done.

LGTM at replayed head 467f552: native review found no code blocker; binary-read focused test passes after replay; source diff is unchanged. Merge remains gated on the unrelated current-main brief budget failure reproduced in clean lead-check.
LGTM at 5077384b885d60033f9d1f8509ad2bd8db2506fb: byte-exact public binary evidence reads, selector bounds, disclosure/digest binding, 22 focused tests and full 1,107-test gate pass.
